Load the authoring skill BEFORE you write or change a .tf or \*.turf.hcl file: a configuration from a request in plain language ("create an S3 bucket", "use the Azure AVM disk module"), an edit the user asked for, or an overlay. Covers the edit → init → up loop, discovery (provider_describe, a module's own files), layout, keeping secrets out of files, expression syntax, moved/removed/import blocks, declaring actions and triggers, and the directory as the desired-state store. Load skill_deployment first.

**[Tiers](/docs/reference/server/#tiers):** read · plan · apply · full
